phrases.m: 在一个小型聚会上发言

ex.en: The annual gathering of scientists provides a rare chance for researchers from different countries to exchange ideas.
ex.zh: 这一年一度的科学家聚会为各国研究人员提供了难得的交流机会。

senses: n. 测量仪器(或仪表),计量器；宽度,厚度
n./v. (用于判断的)标准,尺度；判定,评价；测量；估计

phrases.m: 燃料表,汽油量表,温度计等

ex.en: Economists use consumer spending to gauge the overall health of the economy.
ex.zh: 经济学家利用消费者支出来判断整体经济的健康状况。

senses: a. 愉快的；充满乐趣的；鲜艳的；同性恋的

ex.en: The judgement was hailed as a milestone by gay rights groups across the country.
ex.zh: 这一判决被全国各地的同性恋权利组织誉为里程碑。

gaze.usage: 发音类似"尬死"→被别人一直"盯着，凝视"着看，很尴尬；索引p409

ex.en: In his last years, he lived almost entirely secluded from the public gaze.
ex.zh: 在他生命的最后几年，他几乎没有受到公众的关注。

ex.en: We know that a typical infant will instinctively gaze into its mother's eyes, and she will look back.
ex.zh: 我们知道，婴儿一般会本能地注视着母亲的眼睛，而母亲也会注视自己孩子的眼睛来回应。

ex.en: She gazed out of the window, lost in thought.
ex.zh: 她凝望着窗外，陷入了沉思。

ex.en: Under the gaze of millions of television viewers, the astronaut stepped onto the moon.
ex.zh: 在数百万电视观众的注视下，宇航员踏上了月球。

senses: n. 齿轮,传动装置,(排)档

phrases.p: be geared to the needs of mature students

phrases.m: 处于工作状态,处于就绪状态

gear.usage: 【记】他们正在调整这台车的齿轮装置，使其与离合器相适应。族gearing n.齿轮装置；近adapt vt.使适合；索引p409

ex.en: The company geared its new products towards younger customers.
ex.zh: 公司使新产品面向更年轻的顾客。

ex.en: All the climbing gear must be checked before we set out.
ex.zh: 出发前必须检查所有攀岩装备。

ex.en: Change gear before you start going down the steep hill.
ex.zh: 下陡坡前请换挡。

ex.en: The engineer adjusted the gearing of the machine so that it could run smoothly at higher speeds.
ex.zh: 工程师调整了机器的齿轮装置，使其能在更高转速下平稳运转。

ex.en: The study examines how gender affects career progression in science.
ex.zh: 该研究考察性别如何影响科学界的职业晋升。

ex.en: Applicants should not be asked about gender, age or family status.
ex.zh: 不应询问应聘者的性别、年龄或家庭状况。

ex.en: The university has narrowed the gender gap in engineering courses.
ex.zh: 该大学缩小了工科课程中的性别差距。

gene.usage: 音"基因"；gene pool 基因库;关联:genesis起源;genetics遗传学;genome基因组；n.基因；索引p409

ex.en: Though not biologically related, friends are as "related" as fourth cousins, sharing about 1% of genes.
ex.zh: 虽然不存在血缘关系，但朋友就像我们的第四代表亲一样，与我们有约1%的基因相同。

ex.en: Scientists have identified the gene responsible for the disorder.
ex.zh: 科学家已找到导致这种疾病的基因。

ex.en: The gene for blue eyes can skip several generations.
ex.zh: 蓝眼睛的基因可能隔了好几代才显现。

ex.en: A single gene can influence several apparently unrelated traits.
ex.zh: 单个基因可以影响几种看似无关的性状。

senses: a. 一般的；总的；大体的
general.usage: general knowledge 常识,人所共知的事

ex.en: In general, rural applicants face longer journeys to the nearest testing centre.
ex.zh: 总体而言，农村申请者前往最近的考试中心需要更长的路途。

ex.en: Companies increasingly value the generalist who can move freely between departments and understand the business as a whole.
ex.zh: 企业越来越看重能够在部门之间自由切换并通观全局的通才。

senses: v. 推广,普及;使普通化
generalize.usage: 同义:summarize,expand;派生:generalization n.归纳,概括;亦作 generalise

ex.en: Researchers caution that it is misleading to generalize from a small sample to the whole population.
ex.zh: 研究人员提醒，从小样本推广到整个人群会产生误导。

senses: vt. 产生（电等能量）；造成
generate.usage: v.产生，引起；v.产生，引起；发电；词根记忆:gen(birth,生育)+er+ate(动词后缀)→产生；索引p409

ex.en: However, Allen believed that the unconscious mind generates as much action as the conscious mind.
ex.zh: 然而，艾伦认为，无意识的头脑产生的行动与有意识的头脑一样多。

ex.en: While fossil fuels—coal, oil, gas—still generate roughly 85 percent of the world's energy supply, it's clearer than ever that the future belongs to renewable sources such as wind and solar.
ex.zh: 虽然世界上约85%的能源供应仍由化石燃料——煤炭、石油、天然气——产生，但未来是属于类似风能和太阳能这类可再生能源的，这一点比以往任何时候都更清晰明了。

ex.en: The new scheme is expected to generate hundreds of jobs in the region.
ex.zh: 新方案预计将在该地区创造数百个就业岗位。

senses: n. 一代人；（家史中的）一代，一辈；（尤指电、热等的）产生；（产品发展，尤指技术方面的）代

ex.en: My generation grew up without mobile phones or the internet.
ex.zh: 我这一代人是在没有手机和互联网的环境中长大的。

ex.en: The skill of handwriting may die out within a generation.
ex.zh: 手写技能可能在一代人之内消亡。

ex.en: The new power station will supply cheap electricity to the next generation of factories.
ex.zh: 这座新电站将为新一代工厂提供廉价电力。

senses: adj. 一代的；代与代之间的

ex.en: The survey reveals a sharp generational divide in attitudes toward marriage and career.
ex.zh: 这项调查揭示出在婚姻与职业态度上鲜明的代际差异。

senses: a. 有生产力的；能生产的；有生殖力的
adj. 有生产力的,能生产的,有生殖力的
adj. （语言学中）生成的；有生产能力的；促使…生成的

ex.en: Generative AI models can now produce realistic images from short text descriptions.
ex.zh: 生成式人工智能模型如今能够根据简短的文字描述生成逼真的图像。

ex.en: The linguist studied the generative capacity of grammar in young children.
ex.zh: 这位语言学家研究了幼儿语法的生成能力。

ex.en: Critics worry that generative tools may flood the market with low-quality content.
ex.zh: 批评者担心生成式工具可能使市场上充斥低质量内容。

ex.en: The hospital installed a backup generator to keep life-support equipment running during power cuts.
ex.zh: 医院安装了备用发电机，以便在停电时维持生命支持设备的运转。

ex.en: The scholarship was established through the generosity of a former student who once could not afford tuition.
ex.zh: 这项奖学金由一位曾经付不起学费的往届学生慷慨捐资设立。

senses: adj. 慷慨的，大方的，丰富的
adj. 慷慨的；充足的；宽宏大量的

phrases.p: stop generous funding to the housing sector
phrases.m: 停止对房地产部门慷慨的资助

generous.usage: adj.慷慨的，大方的；大量的； 宽宏大量的；adj.慷慨的；大量的；宽宏大量 的；gener（表示“产生，不断地产生”）+ous（形容词后缀）→丰富的→有大量丰富的资源才能“慷慨的，大方的”；词根记忆：gen(creation, 产生)+er+ous(有…性质的)→产生了同情心，于是慷慨相助→慷慨的；索引p409

ex.en: The gallery was named after its most generous benefactor.
ex.zh: 画廊以其最慷慨的捐助者命名。

ex.en: Politicians have repeatedly "backloaded" public-sector pay deals, keeping the pay increases modest but adding to holidays and especially pensions that are already generous.
ex.zh: 政客们再三“变相地提高”公共部门工资协议中承诺的薪酬待遇——让薪资涨幅不大，但却增加了假期，尤其增加了本已很丰厚的养老金。

ex.en: It was generous of him to donate his entire prize to the school.
ex.zh: 他把全部奖金捐给学校，非常慷慨。

ex.en: Some diseases are caused by genetic factors rather than lifestyle.
ex.zh: 有些疾病由遗传因素而非生活方式引起。

ex.en: The team compares genetic material from ancient and modern wheat.
ex.zh: 团队比较古代小麦与现代小麦的遗传物质。

ex.en: Twin studies suggest that intelligence has a strong genetic component.
ex.zh: 双生子研究表明智力有很强的遗传成分。

senses: adv. 从基因方面,从遗传学角度

ex.en: Genetically modified crops can resist pests without heavy use of chemicals.
ex.zh: 转基因作物无需大量使用化学品就能抵抗害虫。

ex.en: The mice in the experiment were genetically identical to one another.
ex.zh: 实验中的小鼠在基因上完全相同。

ex.en: Some people are genetically more likely to develop the disease.
ex.zh: 有些人从基因上更容易患这种病。

ex.en: The geneticist spent a decade mapping the genes linked to the disorder.
ex.zh: 这位遗传学家花了十年时间绘制与该疾病相关的基因图谱。

ex.en: As a geneticist, she often explains complex findings in plain language.
ex.zh: 作为一名遗传学家，她经常用通俗的语言解释复杂的发现。

ex.en: Geneticists warn that the benefits of gene editing must be weighed against the risks.
ex.zh: 遗传学家们警告说，必须将基因编辑的收益与风险加以权衡。

genetics.usage: n.遗传学；联想记忆:gene(基因)+tics(…学)→遗传学；索引p409

ex.en: She studies genetics at a medical school in Boston.
ex.zh: 她在波士顿一所医学院学习遗传学。

ex.en: Advances in genetics have transformed the diagnosis of rare diseases.
ex.zh: 遗传学的进步改变了罕见病的诊断方式。

ex.en: Modern genetics shows that race is not a fixed biological category.
ex.zh: 现代遗传学表明种族并非固定的生物学类别。

senses: n. 天才，天才人物；天赋
genius.usage: ge（联想成哥哥）+niu（牛）+s→哥哥很牛，他在我们眼里就是个天才

ex.en: She was at the peak of her creative genius.
ex.zh: 她的创作力处于巅峰状态。

ex.en: Mapping the rice genome allowed breeders to develop varieties that survive flooding.
ex.zh: 绘制水稻基因组图谱使育种者得以培育出耐涝品种。

ex.en: Equally, in poetry, the highly personal, performative genre is the only form that could claim real liveliness.
ex.zh: 同样，在诗歌领域中，高度个性化和富有表现力的创作流派成了能够表达真实生动的唯一形式。

senses: a. 文静的；温柔的；温和的；柔和的；平缓的
adj. 和蔼的,文雅的,有礼貌的
gentle.usage: [族]gently ad. 轻柔地；gen(发生)+tle→让事情从容的发生→温和的,文雅的

ex.en: Even gentle exercise, done regularly, measurably reduces the risk of heart disease in older adults.
ex.zh: 即使是经常进行的温和运动，也能显著降低老年人患心脏病的风险。

senses: n. 有教养的人；君子；先生

ex.en: The chairman thanked the gentleman whose anonymous donation saved the swimming pool.
ex.zh: 主席感谢了那位以匿名捐款拯救了游泳池的先生。

senses: ad. 温柔地；温和地；文静地；和缓地

ex.en: The nurse gently reminded the patient that skipping medication would undo weeks of progress.
ex.zh: 护士温和地提醒病人，漏服药会使数周的疗效前功尽弃。

senses: adj. 真的,非人造的,名副其实的
adj. 真的；真诚的；诚恳的
genuine.usage: 同义:real,authentic,true;反义:false;派生genuineness n.真心,真诚；adj.真正的；真诚的，真心的；发音类似姐牛→姐姐很牛，这是真的→真的；索引p409

ex.en: This suggests that rats perceived the social robot as a genuine social being.
ex.zh: 这表明老鼠将社交机器鼠看作真正的社会生物。

ex.en: Experts confirmed that the painting was a genuine Van Gogh.
ex.zh: 专家们确认这幅画是凡·高的真迹。

ex.en: She showed genuine concern for the families affected by the flood.
ex.zh: 她对受洪水影响的家庭表现出真诚的关切。

ex.en: Many consumers say they genuinely care about the environmental impact of the products they buy.
ex.zh: 许多消费者表示，他们真心关注所购产品的环境影响。

ex.en: Subjects such as geography and geology take their name from the Greek root geo, meaning the earth.
ex.zh: 地理学和地质学等学科的名称都源于希腊词根 geo，意为地球。

ex.en: For centuries people accepted the geocentric view that the sun and stars move around the earth.
ex.zh: 几个世纪以来，人们一直接受以地球为中心的观点，认为太阳和星辰绕地球运转。

ex.en: The distribution of wildlife species often follows clear geographic patterns determined by climate and terrain.
ex.zh: 野生动物物种的分布往往遵循由气候和地形决定的清晰地理格局。

ex.en: The country's geographical position gives it easy access to both European and Asian markets.
ex.zh: 该国的地理位置使其能便捷地进入欧洲和亚洲两个市场。

ex.en: The geography of the region made road building extremely expensive and slow.
ex.zh: 该地区的地理条件使修路成本极高、进展缓慢。

ex.en: The geological evidence suggests that the lake was formed by volcanic activity millions of years ago.
ex.zh: 地质证据表明，这个湖是数百万年前的火山活动形成的。

ex.en: The geologist warned that continued mining could destabilize the slopes above the village.
ex.zh: 这位地质学家警告说，持续采矿可能会破坏村庄上方山坡的稳定。

ex.en: A basic knowledge of geology helps engineers assess the risk of earthquakes in this area.
ex.zh: 地质学的基础知识有助于工程师评估该地区的地震风险。

geometry.usage: analytical geometry解析几何;plane geometry平面几何

ex.en: Ancient Egyptian surveyors used practical geometry to redraw field boundaries after the annual flooding of the Nile.
ex.zh: 古埃及测量员利用实用几何学，在尼罗河每年泛滥后重新划定田地边界。

ex.en: English words built on the root ger or gest, such as gesture and digest, all involve the idea of carrying.
ex.zh: 英语中由词根 ger 或 gest 构成的词，如 gesture 和 digest，都含有携带、运送之意。

germ.usage: 发音类似"这么多"→手上这么多细菌→细菌

ex.en: Dirty hands can be a breeding ground for germs.
ex.zh: 脏手可能滋生病菌。

ex.en: Washing your hands removes germs that could make you ill.
ex.zh: 洗手可以清除可能使你生病的细菌。

ex.en: Cover your mouth when you cough so as not to spread germs.
ex.zh: 咳嗽时捂住嘴，以免传播病菌。

ex.en: The idea contained the germ of a promising business plan.
ex.zh: 这个想法蕴藏着一份有前景的商业计划的萌芽。

books.unit: 附录 I 部分国家(或地区)名称及相关信息

ex.en: Germany has invested heavily in renewable energy, becoming one of the world's leading producers of wind power.
ex.zh: 德国在可再生能源上投入巨资，已成为世界主要的风力发电国之一。

senses: v. 做手势,用动作示意
n. 姿势，手势；姿态，表示
gesture.usage: n.手势，姿势；姿态，表示 v.打手势，用动作示意

ex.en: Ambady suspected that deliberation focused them on vivid but misleading cues, such as certain gestures or utterances.
ex.zh: 安巴迪怀疑，深思使参与者将精力集中于那些生动但具有误导性的信号，比如特定的手势或说话方式。

ex.en: He made a generous gesture by paying for the entire team's dinner.
ex.zh: 他慷慨解囊，请全队吃了晚饭，以此表示友好。

ex.en: The teacher gestured to the students to take their seats.
ex.zh: 老师做手势示意学生们就座。

senses: vt. 收到；接到；获得；收听到

ex.en: Young people find it increasingly hard to get a stable job in a slowing economy.
ex.zh: 在放缓的经济中，年轻人越来越难获得一份稳定的工作。

ex.en: We got rid of all the old furniture.
ex.zh: 我们扔掉了所有的旧家具。

ex.en: According to local legend, a ghost walks the castle walls on nights when the moon is full.
ex.zh: 据当地传说，月圆之夜会有一个鬼魂在城堡的城墙上游荡。

senses: n. 大公司；巨人；伟人；巨兽

ex.en: The power and ambition of the giants of the digital economy is astonishing.
ex.zh: 数字经济巨头的实力和野心令人瞠目结舌。

ex.en: Her gift for languages allowed her to master six of them before leaving school.
ex.zh: 她在语言方面的天赋使她在毕业离校前就掌握了六门语言。

senses: n. 现场演出;双轮轻便马车;(临时的)工作

ex.en: Live music fans now spend more on a single gig than on recorded music in an entire year.
ex.zh: 如今现场音乐迷看一场演出的花费，比全年购买录制的音乐还要多。

ex.en: Adjectives such as gigantic derive from the root gigant, conveying the sense of enormous size.
ex.zh: gigantic 等形容词都源自词根 gigant，表示体量巨大之意。

gigantic.usage: 泰坦尼克（Titanic）是一艘巨大的（gigantic）游轮；联想记忆：gigant(看成giant,巨人)+ic(形容词后缀)→巨大的。；索引p409

ex.en: Small choices now may turn out to have gigantic consequences later.
ex.zh: 现在的微小的选择可能会在以后产生巨大的后果。

ex.en: have gigantic consequences
ex.zh: 产生重大的后果

senses: n. 咯咯笑,傻笑;娱乐;持续的笑
giggle.usage: 派生giggly adj. 爱傻笑的,咯咯笑的；索引p409

ex.en: The children giggled when the teacher tripped over the cable in the classroom.
ex.zh: 老师在教室里被电线绊倒时，孩子们咯咯地笑了。

ex.en: The giraffe's extraordinary neck allows it to reach leaves high in the trees that other animals cannot touch.
ex.zh: 长颈鹿奇特的长颈使它能够吃到其他动物够不到的高处树叶。

ex.en: The programme offers girls in rural areas equal access to quality education.
ex.zh: 该项目为农村女孩提供接受优质教育的平等机会。

senses: vt.&vi. 赠送；赠予；送给；捐助；捐款

ex.en: Universities give increasing weight to applicants' practical experience, not just their examination results.
ex.zh: 大学越来越看重申请人的实践经历，而不仅仅是考试分数。

ex.en: Melting glaciers in high mountains threaten the water supply of millions of people living downstream.
ex.zh: 高山冰川的融化威胁着下游数百万居民的水源供应。

ex.en: I am glad to hear that your father has recovered.
ex.zh: 听说你父亲康复了，我很高兴。

ex.en: She was glad of the chance to explain her side of the story.
ex.zh: 她很高兴有机会说明自己这方的情况。

ex.en: We are glad that the dispute was settled without going to court.
ex.zh: 我们很高兴这场争端没有诉诸法庭就得到解决。

ex.en: Advertising often sells products by attaching glamor to ordinary objects, from cars to bottled water.
ex.zh: 广告常常通过赋予普通物品魅力来销售产品，从汽车到瓶装水皆如此。

senses: a. 特别富有魅力的；富于刺激的；独特的
glamorous.usage: adj.迷人的，富有魅力的；索引p409

ex.en: Modelling looks glamorous, but the hours are long and the pay is low.
ex.zh: 模特职业看似光鲜，但工作时间长、报酬低。

ex.en: The actress led a glamorous life of parties and world travel.
ex.zh: 这位女演员过着宴会不断、环游世界的光鲜生活。

ex.en: The magazine presents an unrealistic, glamorous picture of city life.
ex.zh: 这本杂志呈现了不真实的、光鲜迷人的城市生活图景。

ex.en: The glamour of city life fades quickly for newcomers who face high rents and long working hours.
ex.zh: 对那些面临高房租和长工时的新来者而言，都市生活的魅力很快就褪去了。

senses: v. 瞥一眼；匆匆一看；扫视
glance.usage: 发音类似"哥懒死"→哥哥特懒，看东西"瞥一眼"就不管了→一瞥；索引p409

ex.en: She glanced at her watch.
ex.zh: 她匆匆看了看表。

ex.en: At first glance this might seem like a strength that grants the ability to make judgments which are unbiased by external factors.
ex.zh: 乍一看这似乎是个优点，即给予我们不受外界影响而给出公正看法的能力。

ex.en: The manager took a quick glance at the report before the meeting.
ex.zh: 开会前，经理快速浏览了一下报告。

senses: n. 怒视,瞪眼;(发)强光,耀眼的光
n. 怒目而视；刺眼的光
v. 发出刺眼的光线；怒视
glare.usage: 派生glaring adj. 耀眼的,明显的；g(哥)+la(拉)+re(阿姨)→哥哥街上拉错阿姨，阿姨可能"怒目而视"；索引p409

ex.en: For a moment she was blinded by the harsh glare of the sun.
ex.zh: 她一时被刺眼的阳光照得眼昏花。

ex.en: He gave me an angry glare and left the room.
ex.zh: 他狠狠瞪了我一眼，离开了房间。

ex.en: The glare of the computer screen tired her eyes.
ex.zh: 电脑屏幕的强光使她眼睛疲劳。

ex.en: They stood glaring at each other across the negotiating table.
ex.zh: 他们隔着谈判桌怒目相视。

senses: n. 玻璃;玻璃杯;镜子;(pl.)眼镜

ex.en: Recycling glass saves raw materials and considerably reduces the energy consumed in production.
ex.zh: 回收玻璃可节省原材料，并大大减少生产中的能耗。

ex.en: A faint gleam of light from the lighthouse guided the fishing boats safely back to the harbor.
ex.zh: 灯塔透出的微弱光亮引导渔船安全返回港口。

ex.en: Seabirds can glide for hours over the ocean with barely a single wingbeat.
ex.zh: 海鸟能几乎不扇动一下翅膀就在海面上滑翔数小时。

glimpse.usage: 辨析:glimpse较强调动作的结果;glance强调动作的过程；g(哥)+li(立)+m(美女)+pse→哥哥只敢"瞥"美女一下→瞥见；一瞥；索引p409

ex.en: He caught a glimpse of her in the crowd.
ex.zh: 他一眼瞥见她在人群里。

ex.en: The study offers a glimpse of how far artificial intelligence has advanced in recent years.
ex.zh: 这项研究让人得以一窥近年来人工智能已发展到何种程度。

ex.en: Readers get only a brief glimpse of the author's childhood in the opening chapter.
ex.zh: 在开篇章节中，读者只能匆匆一瞥作者的童年。

senses: vi. 闪闪发亮(或发光),光彩夺目,闪耀
n. 灿烂的光辉；闪烁；闪耀
v. 闪亮；闪耀；光彩夺目
glitter.usage: 同义glow,shine,glimmer,sparkle;派生glittery adj.闪光的,闪烁的；g（联想成“改”）+litter（垃圾）→他把垃圾改造成光彩夺目的工艺品→闪烁；闪耀；光彩夺目。

ex.en: The ceiling of the cathedral glittered with gold.
ex.zh: 大教堂的天花板金光闪闪。

senses: a. 全球的；全世界的；整体的；全面的
global.usage: adj.全球的，全世界的；全面的， 整体的；索引p409

ex.en: Climate change is a global problem that no country can solve alone.
ex.zh: 气候变化是一个任何国家都无法单独解决的全球性问题。

ex.en: The company plans to launch the product on the global market next year.
ex.zh: 该公司计划明年将这款产品推向全球市场。

ex.en: Economists warned of a global recession if trade barriers continued to rise.
ex.zh: 经济学家警告说，如果贸易壁垒继续升高，可能出现全球性衰退。

ex.en: Critics argue that to globalise trade too quickly can destroy small local industries that cannot compete.
ex.zh: 批评者指出，过快地推行贸易全球化可能会摧毁无力竞争的小型地方产业。

ex.en: With each advance in globalization and the I.T. revolution, the best jobs will require workers to have more and better education to make themselves above average.
ex.zh: 随着全球化和信息技术革命的每一次进步，最好的工作会要求员工接受更多、更好的教育，使他们自己超越"普通"工作者。

ex.en: Globalization has made national economies increasingly dependent on one another.
ex.zh: 全球化使各国经济日益相互依赖。

ex.en: Critics argue that globalization benefits wealthy countries at the expense of poorer ones.
ex.zh: 批评者认为，全球化以牺牲较贫穷国家的利益为代价造福富裕国家。

globalize.usage: 书中词头作globalise/-ize，英式亦拼作globalise

ex.en: There's the fact that large American companies are much more globalized than ever before.
ex.zh: 有一个事实：美国的大公司比以往任何时候都更加全球化。

ex.en: Globally, more than half of the population now lives in cities, placing huge pressure on public services.
ex.zh: 全球现在有超过一半的人口居住在城市，给公共服务带来巨大压力。

ex.en: The programme is now broadcast to millions of viewers across the globe.
ex.zh: 该节目目前向全球数百万观众播出。

ex.en: Temperatures have risen steadily in almost every region of the globe.
ex.zh: 全球几乎所有地区的气温都在稳步上升。

ex.en: The teacher spun the globe and asked the students to name the country under her finger.
ex.zh: 老师转动地球仪，让学生们说出她手指所指的国家名称。

senses: n. 忧郁；愁闷；无望；幽暗；黑暗；昏暗

ex.en: Despite the gloom surrounding the economy, some industries continue to expand steadily.
ex.zh: 尽管经济笼罩在忧郁之中，一些行业仍在稳步扩张。

ex.en: Psychologists link constant gloominess about the future to higher levels of stress and poorer physical health.
ex.zh: 心理学家认为，对未来持续悲观与更高的压力水平和更差的身体状况有关。

senses: adj. 令人沮丧的,抑郁的
gloomy.usage: 【记】天空阴暗(gloomy)，不一会儿就下雨了。近depressing a.令人沮丧的；反bright a.明亮的；派生gloomily adv.阴沉地;gloominess n.阴暗；adj.阴暗的；沮丧的；前景黯淡的

ex.en: Economists are gloomy about the country's growth prospects this year.
ex.zh: 经济学家们对该国今年的增长前景感到悲观。

ex.en: It was a gloomy winter afternoon, with thick fog over the harbor.
ex.zh: 那是一个阴沉的冬日午后，海港上空浓雾弥漫。

ex.en: The report paints a gloomy picture of the region's water supplies.
ex.zh: 该报告对该地区的水资源状况描绘了一幅暗淡的图景。

ex.en: The museum's glorious collection of paintings attracts visitors from every corner of the world.
ex.zh: 博物馆辉煌的绘画藏品吸引着来自世界各地的参观者。

senses: n. [U] 荣誉；光荣；桂冠；赞颂；壮丽
glory.usage: 反义dishonour n.耻辱,丢脸；n.光荣，荣誉；壮丽，辉煌；真 public glory 社会荣耀；restore the glory of former times 恢复往日的辉煌；索引p409

ex.en: The team restored its former glory by winning the championship again.
ex.zh: 这支球队再次夺冠，重振昔日辉煌。

ex.en: The glory of the ancient temple still attracts visitors from around the world.
ex.zh: 古神庙的辉煌壮观仍吸引着世界各地的游客。

ex.en: She achieved scientific glory when her theory was finally confirmed.
ex.zh: 当她的理论最终得到证实时，她获得了科学上的荣耀。

ex.en: Workers must wear protective gloves when handling dangerous chemicals in the laboratory.
ex.zh: 在实验室处理危险化学品时，工人必须戴防护手套。

senses: vi. 发出柔和平稳的光；发热；喜形于色
n. [sing.] 微弱平稳的光；红晕；喜悦
vi. 发热,发光,发红;色彩强烈,绚丽夺目
n. 微弱稳定的光；容光焕发，满脸通红
v. 发微弱而稳定的光；发光；发热
glow.usage: 同义glitter,burn,shine,blush,flush；发音类似“阁楼”→阁楼里发出的光照亮了整个房子→发光。；索引p409

ex.en: The lighted candles glowed in the darkness.
ex.zh: 点燃的蜡烛在黑暗中发出微弱的光。

ex.en: The children's faces glowed with excitement as the show began.
ex.zh: 演出开始时，孩子们的脸上洋溢着兴奋的光彩。

ex.en: The sunset cast a warm red glow over the quiet valley.
ex.zh: 夕阳给宁静的山谷披上了一层温暖的红光。

senses: adj. 热烈赞扬的；热情洋溢的

ex.en: He spoke of her performance in the film in glowing terms.
ex.zh: 他热烈赞扬了她在影片中的表演。

senses: ad. 热情洋溢地；热烈赞扬地
adv. 热烈赞扬地,热情洋溢地
adv. 热心地；热情洋溢地

ex.en: Up until a few decades ago, our visions of the future were largely glowingly positive.
ex.zh: 直到几十年前，我们对于未来的展望基本上是极为乐观的。

ex.en: Early reviewers spoke glowingly of the novel, praising its vivid characters and moral depth.
ex.zh: 早期评论家对这部小说赞不绝口，称赞其生动的人物和道德深度。

ex.en: The report describes the city's public transport system glowingly, noting its reliability and low cost.
ex.zh: 该报告对这座城市的公共交通系统大加赞扬，指出其可靠性和低成本。

ex.en: In his memoir he recalls glowingly the teachers who first encouraged him to write.
ex.zh: 在回忆录中，他满怀热情地回忆起最初鼓励他写作的老师们。

phrases.p: remain glued to the computer screen

glue.usage: 【记】胶水(glue)把图片粘在了一张蓝色的纸上。搭配be glued to...紧贴着……；盯住……不放

ex.en: Unlike nails, strong glue can join materials together without damaging their surface.
ex.zh: 与钉子不同，强力胶水可以在不损坏材料表面的情况下将其粘合。

ex.en: All flight schedules at the airport are listed in GMT to avoid confusion across time zones.
ex.zh: 机场所有航班时刻表均以格林尼治时间标注，以避免时区混淆。

ex.en: Words containing the root gn or gnor, such as recognise and ignorant, are connected with knowing.
ex.zh: 含有词根 gn 或 gnor 的词，如 recognise 和 ignorant，都与知道这一意义相关。

senses: vi. 去；走；离开；离去；出发；（事情）进展

ex.en: Sales went down sharply after the price of the product was raised last spring.
ex.zh: 去年春天产品提价后，销量急剧下降。

ex.en: Setting a realistic goal is the first step toward improving your academic writing.
ex.zh: 设定一个现实的目标是提高学术写作水平的第一步。

ex.en: Sociologists argue that a sense of goallessness among unemployed youth can lead to crime and social unrest.
ex.zh: 社会学家认为，失业青年中的无目标感可能导致犯罪和社会动荡。

ex.en: In mountainous areas, goats are often raised for milk, meat and wool.
ex.zh: 在山区，人们常饲养山羊以获取奶、肉和羊毛。

ex.en: Early travelers carried water in goatskin bags because such containers were light and easy to repair.
ex.zh: 早期的旅行者用山羊皮袋装水，因为这种容器轻便且易于修补。

ex.en: Ancient Greeks believed that each god controlled a different aspect of human life.
ex.zh: 古希腊人认为每位神掌管人类生活的不同方面。

ex.en: Gold prices rose sharply as investors sought a safe place for their money.
ex.zh: 随着投资者为其资金寻求安全去处，金价急剧上涨。

senses: adj. 金子般的;金黄色的

ex.en: The discovery of the ancient tomb is regarded as a golden opportunity for research.
ex.zh: 这座古墓的发现被视为研究的一次黄金机会。

ex.en: Business deals are often discussed on the golf course rather than in the office.
ex.zh: 商业交易常在高尔夫球场上而非办公室里洽谈。

ex.en: Regular exercise does good to both physical health and mental wellbeing.
ex.zh: 定期锻炼对身体健康和心理健康都有好处。

ex.en: She said goodbye to her colleagues and left for a research post abroad.
ex.zh: 她向同事们道别，前往国外担任研究职务。

senses: n. 善良；优良；美德；营养

ex.en: The novel celebrates the essential goodness of ordinary people in hard times.
ex.zh: 这部小说颂扬了艰难时期普通人固有的善良。

ex.en: Online shopping allows consumers to compare the prices of goods across many stores.
ex.zh: 网上购物使消费者能够比较多家商店的商品价格。

ex.en: Each autumn, wild geese fly south in search of warmer wetlands.
ex.zh: 每年秋天，野鹅南飞寻找更温暖的湿地。

senses: adj. 宜人的,爽快的,豪华的

ex.en: The palace's gorgeous interior, with its gold ceilings and silk curtains, took thirty years to complete.
ex.zh: 宫殿华丽的内部装饰——金色天花板和丝绸帷幔——花费了三十年才完成。

ex.en: Conservationists estimate that fewer than a thousand mountain gorillas survive in the wild today.
ex.zh: 保护专家估计，如今野外存活的山地大猩猩已不足一千只。

senses: n. 福音书(《圣经》中记载耶稣生平和教诲的四卷书)
n. 福音;教义;信条;绝对真实;福音音乐

ex.en: Some economists treat market efficiency as gospel, despite growing evidence that markets often behave irrationally.
ex.zh: 一些经济学家把市场效率奉为绝对真理，尽管越来越多的证据表明市场行为常常不理性。

senses: v. 传播流言蜚语;闲聊

ex.en: Office gossip can damage trust among colleagues and lower work efficiency.
ex.zh: 办公室的闲言碎语会损害同事间的信任并降低工作效率。

govern.usage: [族]government n. 政府；治理；【记】他们联合治理这个省。族government n.政府；治理；governor n.州长；省长；govern 与 governor 同根，后者为名词，指统治者；sway 指权势；索引p409

ex.en: Sensible ideas have been around for a long time, but the state-level bodies that govern the profession have been too conservative to implement them.
ex.zh: 改革的良策早已呼之欲出，但监管这个行业的州级机构却太过保守，不愿执行这些方案。

ex.en: Market forces, rather than regulators, largely govern the price of housing in major cities.
ex.zh: 在大城市，房价主要是由市场力量而非监管机构决定的。

ex.en: The rules that govern corporate behaviour vary widely from one country to another.
ex.zh: 规范公司行为的规则在国与国之间差异很大。

ex.en: A small council of elders has governed the island community for generations.
ex.zh: 一个由长者组成的小型委员会世代治理着这个岛屿社区。

governance.usage: n.统治方式，管理方法；索引p409

ex.en: Good governance requires transparency, accountability and the rule of law.
ex.zh: 良好的治理需要透明度、问责制和法治。

ex.en: The report criticized the weak corporate governance that allowed the fraud to continue for years.
ex.zh: 该报告批评了薄弱的公司治理，正是这种治理不善使欺诈行为得以持续多年。

ex.en: Reformers are pushing for a new model of urban governance that gives residents a greater voice.
ex.zh: 改革者正在推动一种让居民拥有更大发言权的城市治理新模式。

senses: ②(国家等的)统治，管理，支配
government.usage: n.政府；政体；治理，管理；词根记忆：govern(治理)+ment(名词后缀)→政府；治理；索引p409

ex.en: However, the mechanisms proposed were unwieldy and the Bill was voted down following the change in government later that year.
ex.zh: 然而，提出的这些方法难以执行，并且在那年（指2016年）末政府换届之后，这个议案就被投票否决了。

ex.en: The government has promised to invest more in renewable energy over the next decade.
ex.zh: 政府已承诺在未来十年加大对可再生能源的投资。

ex.en: Critics argue that government spending on the arts delivers real economic and social benefits.
ex.zh: 批评者认为，政府在艺术上的支出能带来实际的经济和社会效益。

ex.en: Local government, rather than national bodies, controls most planning decisions.
ex.zh: 地方而非国家机构控制着大多数规划决定。

phrases.m: 一个政府职业培训项目

governmental.usage: adj.政府的；政治的；统治上的 injury/'ɪndʒəri(词频7)；索引p409

ex.en: Governmental policies on taxation have a direct impact on household spending.
ex.zh: 政府的税收政策对家庭支出有直接影响。

senses: n. 州长；总督；（学校、医院等的）董事；监狱长
governor.usage: n.州长，省长，总督；董事； 主管；索引p409

ex.en: The state governor has proposed a new plan to expand access to early childhood education.
ex.zh: 该州州长提出了一项扩大儿童早期教育机会的新计划。

ex.en: As governor, she pushed through reforms that cut taxes and simplified the state budget.
ex.zh: 担任州长期间，她推动了削减税收和简化州预算的改革。

ex.en: The board of governors will meet next week to discuss the university's funding problems.
ex.zh: 理事会下周将开会讨论这所大学的资金问题。

senses: n. 长袍,法衣,礼服,睡袍

ex.en: Graduates wore traditional gowns at the ceremony held in the main hall.
ex.zh: 毕业生在主楼礼堂举行的典礼上身着传统礼服长袍。

senses: n. 猛然的抓取；突然的抢夺

ex.en: The thief made a grab at my bag but I pushed him away.
ex.zh: 这个贼想抢我的手提包，但被我推开了。

senses: n. 优美，优雅；风度；体面

phrases.p: have the grace to do sth.

grace.usage: g（联想成girl“女孩”）+race（比赛）→女孩们在舞蹈比赛时表现得很“优雅”。；索引p409

ex.en: It is wise to take such gifts with gratitude and grace.
ex.zh: 明智的做法是带着感激和优雅接受这些礼物。

ex.en: She handled the hostile questions with grace, refusing to lose her temper.
ex.zh: 她从容应对那些带有敌意的提问，没有发脾气。

ex.en: The ageing dancer moved with a grace that surprised the younger members of the company.
ex.zh: 这位年迈的舞者举止优雅，令舞团里较年轻的成员大为惊讶。

ex.en: Even in defeat he accepted the result with grace and congratulated his rival.
ex.zh: 即使落败，他也坦然接受结果，并祝贺对手。

senses: adj. 优美的,文雅的,得体的
adj. 优美的；优雅的；雅致的；得体的；有风度的

ex.en: The dancers were all tall and graceful.
ex.zh: 这些舞蹈演员都个子高高的，动作十分优雅。

ex.en: Despite losing the match, she gave a graceful speech congratulating her opponent.
ex.zh: 尽管输掉了比赛，她还是发表了一篇得体的讲话，祝贺对手。

ex.en: The swans moved across the lake in a slow, graceful manner.
ex.zh: 天鹅以缓慢而优雅的姿态游过湖面。

ex.en: Critics dismissed the film as a graceless imitation of earlier classics, lacking originality or charm.
ex.zh: 评论家们批评这部电影是对早期经典的拙劣模仿，既无新意也乏魅力。

senses: adj. (人或行为)(尤指对社会地位较低者)和蔼的,慈祥的,有礼貌的,宽厚的
adj. (常用于名词前)富贵安逸的,优裕的,舒适的

ex.en: The queen was gracious to the kitchen staff, thanking each of them personally after the banquet.
ex.zh: 女王对厨房员工非常和蔼宽厚，宴会后亲自向每一个人道谢。

senses: n. (产品、材料的)等级,品级;(官衔的)级别,职别

phrases.m: 达到必要标准;符合要求;成功

ex.en: Students are graded not only on their exam results but also on class participation.
ex.zh: 学生的评分不仅依据考试成绩，还依据课堂参与度。

ex.en: Teachers say that a fourth grader who reads daily develops vocabulary far faster than one who rarely opens a book.
ex.zh: 老师们说，每天阅读的四年级学生，其词汇增长速度远超很少翻开书本的学生。

gradual.usage: 【记】社会的变化是逐渐的(gradual)。派gradually ad.逐渐地；adj.逐渐的；平缓的；词根记忆：grad(go,走)+u+al(形容词后缀)→慢慢走下去的→逐渐的；索引p409

ex.en: These changes were gradual and at first scarcely visible.
ex.zh: 这些变化是渐进的，起初几乎看不见。

ex.en: There has been a gradual improvement in the patient's condition over the past week.
ex.zh: 在过去一周里，病人的病情逐渐好转。

ex.en: The transition to renewable energy will be a gradual process lasting several decades.
ex.zh: 向可再生能源的过渡将是一个持续数十年的渐进过程。

ex.en: Women have gradually become more involved in the decision-making process.
ex.zh: 妇女逐渐更多地参与决策过程。

ex.en: The old town has gradually changed from an industrial centre into a tourist attraction.
ex.zh: 这座老城已逐渐从工业中心转变为旅游景点。

ex.en: As the medicine took effect, the patient's breathing gradually returned to normal.
ex.zh: 随着药物起效，病人的呼吸逐渐恢复正常。

senses: n. [C] 大学毕业生；（大学、中学等的）毕业生
vi. ['grædʒueɪt] 大学毕业；中学毕业
v. ①(使)(大学)毕业 ②获学位
adj. ①有学位的，毕业的 ②研究生的
graduate.usage: 同义 finish，pass；派生 graduation n. 毕业，毕业典礼；作名词读/ˈɡrædʒuət/，作动词读/ˈɡrædʒueɪt/；n.读'grædʒuət，vi.读'grædʒueɪt；同根词词根grad：to go走；索引p409

ex.en: She has taught at both the undergraduate and graduate levels.
ex.zh: 她本科生和研究生都教过。

ex.en: Many college graduates find that their first job bears little relation to their major.
ex.zh: 许多大学毕业生发现他们的第一份工作与所学专业关系不大。

ex.en: He graduated from law school and soon joined a well-known firm in his hometown.
ex.zh: 他从法学院毕业后很快加入了家乡一家知名律师事务所。

ex.en: Universities report that more graduates are choosing public service over private-sector jobs.
ex.zh: 各大学报告说，越来越多的毕业生选择公共服务而非私营部门的工作。

ex.en: After graduation, many students choose to work for a few years before further study.
ex.zh: 毕业后，许多学生选择先工作几年再继续深造。

grain.usage: 【记】丈夫在田里收割谷物(grain)。搭配go against the grain与……格格不入；违反意愿

ex.en: A balanced diet should include whole grains, fresh vegetables and adequate protein.
ex.zh: 均衡的饮食应包括全谷物、新鲜蔬菜和充足的蛋白质。

ex.en: A single gram of the new material can absorb several liters of water within seconds.
ex.zh: 一克这种新材料能在几秒钟内吸收数升水。

ex.en: British packaging usually states the weight in grammes, while American labels use ounces.
ex.zh: 英国包装通常以克为单位标注重量，而美国标签使用盎司。

ex.en: Reading widely is more effective than memorizing grammar rules in isolation.
ex.zh: 广泛阅读比孤立地背诵语法规则更有效。

senses: adj. 语法的；语法正确的

ex.en: The essay's ideas were original, but its many grammatical errors cost the student a higher grade.
ex.zh: 这篇文章见解新颖，但许多语法错误使这名学生失去了更高的分数。

senses: ②重大的，主要的，最重要的
adj. 宏大的；[G-](用于大建筑物等的名称)大；壮丽的；极好的
grand.usage: 【记】这个宏伟的音乐厅曾经是一个老电影院。；串词记忆：伟大的(great)，宏大的(grand)。；索引p409

ex.en: Finally, there is perspective, which involves acknowledging that in the grand scheme of life, one lecture really doesn't matter.
ex.zh: 最后一个阶段是洞察力，我们要认识到在生命的宏伟蓝图中，一次演讲根本算不上什么。

ex.en: The hotel's grand entrance was designed to impress wealthy travellers.
ex.zh: 这家酒店宏伟的入口旨在给富有的旅客留下深刻印象。

ex.en: The government announced a grand plan to rebuild the entire coastal region.
ex.zh: 政府宣布了一项重建整个沿海地区的宏伟计划。

ex.en: My grandmother, who grew up in a small village, never had the chance to attend school.
ex.zh: 我的祖母在小村庄长大，从未有机会上学。

ex.en: The statue was carved from a single block of granite, which explains why it has survived centuries of weather.
ex.zh: 这座雕像由一整块花岗岩雕成，这也解释了它历经数百年风雨仍保存完好的原因。

ex.en: Many working parents rely on granny to look after the children while they are at the office.
ex.zh: 许多双职工父母上班时依靠奶奶照看孩子。

grant.usage: 【记】委员会同意给他一笔研究拨款。搭配take...for granted认为……理所当然；对……不予重视；take...for granted 认为……理所当然；take it for granted that 认为…理所当然；grant sb sth 授予某人某物。；索引p409

ex.en: International tax rules do not grant them that right.
ex.zh: 国际税收规则没有赋予他们那种权利。

ex.en: The university awarded her a research grant.
ex.zh: 大学授予她一笔科研拨款。

ex.en: We take these services for granted.
ex.zh: 我们认为这些服务是理所当然的。

ex.en: The quality of wine depends largely on the variety of grape and the local climate.
ex.zh: 葡萄酒的质量在很大程度上取决于葡萄品种和当地气候。

ex.en: The graph shows a sharp rise in online shopping during the two years following the pandemic.
ex.zh: 图表显示，疫情后的两年里网络购物急剧增长。

senses: adj. 生动的,书写的,绘画的,图示的

ex.en: The reporter gave a graphic account of the flood, describing families waiting on rooftops for rescue.
ex.zh: 记者对洪水作了生动的描述，讲述了在屋顶上等待救援的人们。

ex.en: Nouns ending in -graphy, such as biography and geography, usually name a field of study or description.
ex.zh: 以 -graphy 结尾的名词，如 biography 和 geography，通常表示某一研究或记述领域。

senses: v. 扭打,搏斗;努力解决(问题)

ex.en: City governments continue to grapple with housing shortages as more people move to urban centers.
ex.zh: 随着越来越多的人涌向城市中心，市政府仍在努力解决住房短缺问题。

phrases.p: grasp the main idea of the passage

grasp.usage: 【记】我一下子就领会了这个论点的含义。近understand vt.理解；v./n.抓牢，握紧；理解，领会； 抓住；他紧紧地抓住（grasp）这个草（grass），往外拔；串词记忆：葡萄(grape)滑滑的，很难抓紧(grasp)；索引p409

ex.en: They failed to grasp the importance of his words.
ex.zh: 他们没有理解他的话的重要性。

ex.en: This is a shame—the community should be grasping the opportunity to raise its influence in the real world.
ex.zh: 这是令人惋惜的——这一群体（指社会科学家）应该抓住这次机会来提高自身在真实世界中的影响力。

ex.en: The drowning man grasped the rope and was pulled to safety.
ex.zh: 溺水的人紧紧抓住绳子，被拉到了安全的地方。

ex.en: The scientists measured how quickly the grass recovered after the long drought.
ex.zh: 科学家们测量了长期干旱后草地的恢复速度。

ex.en: Overgrazing has turned vast areas of grassland into desert, threatening the herders who depend on them.
ex.zh: 过度放牧使大片草原变成沙漠，威胁着依赖草原为生的牧民。

senses: n. 基层民众;平民百姓;草根阶层

ex.en: The reform began as a grassroots movement before it attracted the attention of national politicians.
ex.zh: 这场改革最初是一场草根运动，后来才引起国家政治人物的注意。

ex.en: English words containing the root grat, such as grateful and gratitude, express thankfulness.
ex.zh: 含有词根 grat 的英语词，如 grateful 和 gratitude，都表达感激之情。

phrases.p: be grateful to sb. for sth.

grateful.usage: 【记】对他的帮助我很感激。派gratitude n.感激之情；如果你让一个人（gr联想成一个人）吃（ate）饱（ful联想成full）了，他就会“感谢”你→感激的，感谢的。

ex.en: Instead, being grateful for small things every day is a much better way to improve wellbeing.
ex.zh: 相反，对每天的小事心存感激是一个更好的提高幸福感的方法。

ex.en: We are deeply grateful to the volunteers who worked through the night.
ex.zh: 我们对通宵工作的志愿者们深表感激。

ex.en: He was grateful for the chance to explain his side of the story.
ex.zh: 他很感激能有机会解释他那一方的情况。

senses: n. 满足；令人喜悦的事物
gratification.usage: 词根记忆:grat(pleasing,喜悦)+i+fic(do,做)+ation(名词后缀)→令人喜悦的事物；索引p409

ex.en: Psychologists note that instant gratification often prevents people from achieving long-term goals.
ex.zh: 心理学家指出，即时满足常常阻碍人们实现长期目标。

senses: vt. 使高兴；使满意；满足（愿望、需要等）

ex.en: It gratified the retired teacher to learn that so many of her former students had become doctors and engineers.
ex.zh: 得知那么多昔日的学生成为医生和工程师，这位退休教师深感欣慰。

phrases.p: show gratitude to sb. for sth.

gratitude.usage: 词根记忆：grat(thankful,感谢)+i+tude→感激。；索引p409

ex.en: Her eyes were immediately filled with gratitude.
ex.zh: 她的眼里立刻充满了感激之情。

ex.en: It is wise to take such gifts with gratitude and grace.
ex.zh: 明智的做法就是带着感激和风度接受这样的馈赠。

ex.en: He expressed his deep gratitude to the volunteers who had supported the campaign.
ex.zh: 他向支持这项活动的志愿者表达了深深的谢意。

ex.en: As a token of her gratitude, she invited the whole team to dinner.
ex.zh: 为表感激，她邀请全队共进晚餐。

ex.en: The root grav, meaning heavy, appears in words such as gravity and grave, both linked to weight or seriousness.
ex.zh: 意为重的词根 grav 出现在 gravity 和 grave 等词中，都与重量或严重性相关。

phrases.p: have one foot in the grave

ex.en: He did die as a pauper and was buried in an unmarked grave.
ex.zh: 他死的时候是个穷光蛋，葬在一处无名墓穴中。

ex.en: The scientists warned that climate change poses a grave threat to coastal cities.
ex.zh: 科学家警告说，气候变化对沿海城市构成严重威胁。

ex.en: His expression was grave as he delivered the news of the company's losses.
ex.zh: 他在宣布公司亏损的消息时神情严肃。

ex.en: Archaeologists discovered a royal grave filled with jewellery and weapons.
ex.zh: 考古学家发现了一座满藏珠宝和武器的王室墓穴。

ex.en: The rural road was covered with loose gravel, making the journey slow and uncomfortable for drivers.
ex.zh: 乡间路上满是松动的砾石，使司机的旅程缓慢而不适。

ex.en: Archaeologists discovered an ancient graveyard beneath the car park while preparing the site for construction.
ex.zh: 考古学家在为施工清理场地时，在停车场下面发现了一片古代墓地。

gravity.usage: n.重力，地心引力；严重性； 严肃

ex.en: The moon's gravity pulls the oceans towards it, producing the rise and fall of the tides.
ex.zh: 月球的引力把海洋拉向它，产生了潮汐的涨落。

ex.en: Only when the crisis began did ministers grasp the full gravity of the situation.
ex.zh: 直到危机开始，部长们才意识到局势的严重性。

ex.en: The gravity of his remarks was not lost on the audience.
ex.zh: 听众并没有忽视他这番话的严肃性。

ex.en: The old fishing village presents a gray appearance, its stone houses weathered by decades of sea winds.
ex.zh: 这座古老的渔村呈现出一派灰色调，石屋被数十年的海风吹打得饱经风霜。

senses: n. 皮肤擦伤之处,擦伤

ex.en: Cattle are allowed to graze freely on the hillside during the summer months.
ex.zh: 夏季的几个月里，牛群被允许在山坡上自由吃草。

ex.en: Mechanics apply grease to the moving parts of the engine to reduce friction and wear.
ex.zh: 机械师给发动机的运动部件涂上润滑油，以减少摩擦和磨损。

ex.en: A great many species are threatened by the loss of their natural habitats.
ex.zh: 大量物种正因自然栖息地的丧失而受到威胁。

ex.en: The root gred or gress, meaning to walk or step, appears in progress, which literally means moving forward.
ex.zh: 意为走的词根 gred 或 gress 出现在 progress 一词中，其字面义即向前走。

books.unit: 附录 I 部分国家(或地区)名称及相关信息

ex.en: Greece built its early philosophy and mathematics on contact with the older civilizations of Egypt and Asia.
ex.zh: 希腊早期的哲学和数学是在与埃及、亚洲更古老文明的接触中发展起来的。

ex.en: The financial crisis revealed how corporate greed, left unchecked, can endanger an entire economy.
ex.zh: 金融危机表明，不受约束的企业贪婪会危及整个经济体。

senses: adj. 贪吃的,贪婪的,渴望的
greedy.usage: 【记】贪吃的人往往很贪婪。派greed n.贪婪；贪心；助记:greed(贪婪)+y(形容词后缀)→贪婪的;同义eager

ex.en: Critics argue that greedy lenders were largely responsible for the financial crisis.
ex.zh: 批评者认为，贪婪的放贷者应对金融危机负主要责任。

ex.en: More consumers now prefer green products even if they cost slightly more.
ex.zh: 如今更多消费者偏爱环保产品，即使价格略高。

senses: n. 蔬菜水果店;果蔬商

ex.en: In the past, every neighborhood had its greengrocer, whose stall displayed fresh vegetables each morning.
ex.zh: 过去每个街区都有自己的果蔬商，每天清晨摊位上摆满新鲜蔬菜。

greenhouse.usage: 助记:green(蔬菜)+house(房子)→蔬菜房→温室

ex.en: Farmers use greenhouse technology to grow vegetables through the winter, when open fields yield nothing.
ex.zh: 农民利用温室技术在冬季种植蔬菜，此时露天田地毫无收成。

senses: vt. 对...做出反应;被...感知
greet.usage: 【记】总统亲自迎接外宾。派greeting n.问候；招呼

ex.en: Passengers were greeted by long queues at the airport because of the strike.
ex.zh: 由于罢工，乘客在机场迎接他们的是长长的队伍。

greeting.usage: 助记:greet(问候)+ing(名词后缀)→问候

ex.en: In some cultures, a firm handshake is the standard greeting in business settings.
ex.zh: 在一些文化中，有力的握手是商务场合的标准问候方式。

ex.en: The once green hills have turned grey with dust after years of drought and deforestation.
ex.zh: 多年干旱和滥伐森林之后，曾经青翠的山丘已变得灰蒙蒙一片。

senses: n. 悲伤，悲痛；悲伤的事
grief.usage: 【记】她的死给他带来了极大的悲伤。派grieve vi.感到悲痛

ex.en: Deep grief can affect both physical health and the ability to make decisions.
ex.zh: 深切的悲伤会影响身体健康和决策能力。

senses: n. 不平,委屈;不满,抱怨,牢骚

ex.en: The union organized a meeting where workers could voice any grievance about pay or working conditions.
ex.zh: 工会组织了一次会议，让工人们畅谈对工资或工作条件的任何不满。

grieve.usage: [族]grief n. 悲痛；同义afflict,sadden,mourn;反义please v.使高兴；发音类似“贵啊”→这件衣服好贵啊，我花了好多钱，好伤心啊→使伤心。；索引p409

ex.en: Their lack of interest grieved her.
ex.zh: 他们不感兴趣使她很痛心。

ex.en: Moreover, we are grieving various kinds of loss: a friendship, a romantic relationship or a house.
ex.zh: 除此之外，我们还会为各种失去而感到悲戚：友谊、恋爱关系或是一栋房子。

ex.en: She is still grieving for her husband, who died two years ago.
ex.zh: 她仍在为两年前去世的丈夫悲伤。

ex.en: Fans grieved publicly when the beloved singer passed away.
ex.zh: 这位深受爱戴的歌手去世时，歌迷们公开表达哀伤。

senses: ②严厉的，严峻的；③令人不愉快的
④坚定而无畏的；⑤含不快或恐怖内容的；⑥(指地方)极其简陋的；⑦生病，不舒服；⑧很坏，令人厌恶

ex.en: Unemployment figures paint a grim picture of the region's economy, with youth joblessness at a record high.
ex.zh: 失业数据描绘出该地区经济的严峻景象，青年失业率创下历史新高。

ex.en: Farmers grimly surveyed the withered fields, knowing that another failed harvest would bring real hardship.
ex.zh: 农民们神情沉重地望着枯萎的田地，知道再歉收一年就会带来真正的困苦。

senses: v. 露齿而笑,咧着嘴笑
v. 露齿笑着表示(某事)

phrases.m: 毫无怨言地忍受痛苦、挫折等

ex.en: Unable to hide his relief, the candidate grinned widely as the final results were announced.
ex.zh: 最终结果宣布时，这位候选人再也掩饰不住如释重负的心情，咧嘴大笑起来。

senses: v. 磨；磨碎，碾碎；使锋利；磨光
grind.usage: 搭配grind on缓慢而单调地继续；词组grind down磨碎,压迫;派生grinder n.磨咖啡机,研磨机;grinding adj.刺耳的

ex.en: The flour is ground using traditional methods.
ex.zh: 这面粉是用传统方法磨制而成。

ex.en: Workers had to grind the grain by hand before machines were invented.
ex.zh: 在机器发明之前，工人们不得不用手磨碎谷物。

ex.en: Years of grinding poverty forced many young people to leave the village.
ex.zh: 长年贫困的煎熬迫使许多年轻人离开村庄。

senses: n. 紧握；紧抓；（对……的）控制，影响力；理解；了解
v. 紧握；紧抓；抓牢；使感兴趣；使激动；吸引住（某人）的注意

phrases.p: be in the grip of sth.
phrases.m: 处于无法控制的不利局势中；受制于某事
与……搏斗；(认真)对待(或处理)

grip.usage: 辨析：grip 抓紧用力的程度大大超过 grasp；同义 seize, hold, grasp；反义 loosen 放松；派生 gripping adj. 吸引人的，令人激动的

ex.en: You need to keep a good grip on reality in this job.
ex.zh: 做这个工作你需要充分了解实际情况。

ex.en: Strengthening economic growth, at the same time as winter grips the northern hemisphere, could push the oil price higher still in the short term.
ex.zh: 强劲的经济增长势头，以及北半球冬季的到来，仍有可能在短期内使石油价格涨得更高。

senses: n. 呻吟声；叹息声；抱怨
groan.usage: 发音类似“割肉（买肉）”→阿姨们经常“抱怨”割肉比以前贵；索引p409

ex.en: They're all groaning about soaring health budgets.
ex.zh: 他们都在抱怨不断飙升的医疗预算。

ex.en: The old bridge groaned under the weight of the loaded truck.
ex.zh: 旧桥在满载卡车的重压下发出嘎吱声。

ex.en: He gave a groan of despair when he saw the exam results.
ex.zh: 看到考试结果时，他发出一声绝望的呻吟。

senses: n. 食品店,食品杂货商

ex.en: The local grocer noticed that customers were buying more fresh produce and fewer packaged snacks.
ex.zh: 当地食品杂货商注意到，顾客购买的生鲜农产品增多，包装零食减少。

senses: n. 杂货店，食品杂货铺；食品杂货
grocery.usage: gro（发音类似“果肉”）+c+ery（场所，地方）→有果有肉的地方，就是“杂货店”

ex.en: He walked in and set the bag of groceries down on the floor.
ex.zh: 他走进来，把那袋食品杂货放在地板上。

senses: vt. 给(动物)梳毛刷洗;培训

ex.en: The company grooms talented young employees for senior management positions within a few years.
ex.zh: 公司着力培养有才华的年轻员工，让他们在几年内走上高级管理岗位。

grope.usage: 助记:g+rope(绳索)→一个人沿绳索走→摸索;派生gropingly摸索着,探索着

ex.en: Policymakers are still groping for effective answers to the housing crisis that has lasted a decade.
ex.zh: 对于持续十年之久的住房危机，政策制定者仍在摸索有效的对策。

senses: ②严重的，极端的；③粗俗的，下流的
vt. 总共赚得，获得……总收入
adj. 总的；毛的；严重的；粗鲁的
gross.usage: 反义 net adj. 净余的；派生 grossly adv. 极度地，十分地；gro(联想“果肉”)+ss(联想“丧失”)→果肉丧失毛重量下降→毛的；毛收入；gross income/wage（税前）总收益/工资；索引p409

ex.en: The firm's gross profits rose sharply, but its net earnings remained flat.
ex.zh: 该公司毛利润大幅上升，但净收益保持不变。

ex.en: The court ruled that the company had been guilty of gross negligence in maintaining the equipment.
ex.zh: 法院裁定该公司在设备维护方面存在严重过失。

ex.en: The film grossed over ten million dollars in its opening weekend.
ex.zh: 这部电影在首映周末总收入超过一千万美元。

senses: n. [U] 地面；[C] 场地；理由
ground.usage: 另 shift one's ground 改变立场；be/give/have grounds for 有……理由；on the ground of 因为；ground sth. on sth. 建立于……基础上

ex.en: The negotiation broke down because neither side was willing to find common ground.
ex.zh: 谈判破裂，因为双方都不愿寻找共同立场。

ex.en: The laboratory's groundbreaking research on battery technology may double the range of electric cars.
ex.zh: 该实验室在电池技术方面的开创性研究可能使电动汽车的续航里程翻倍。

ex.en: Officials dismissed the rumor that the water supply was contaminated as completely groundless.
ex.zh: 官方驳斥了有关供水受到污染的传言，称其毫无根据。

ex.en: The subjects were divided into two groups to compare the effects of the treatment.
ex.zh: 受试者被分成两组，以比较该疗法的效果。

ex.en: Demand for electric vehicles is expected to grow rapidly over the next decade.
ex.zh: 未来十年，电动汽车的需求预计将迅速增长。

senses: a. 成年的；体现成年人责任的，成熟的

ex.en: Children often imitate the behaviour of the grown-ups around them.
ex.zh: 孩子们常常模仿身边成年人的行为。

senses: n. [U] 成长；发育；增加；增长；经济发展

ex.en: Rapid population growth puts enormous pressure on housing and public services.
ex.zh: 快速的人口增长给住房和公共服务带来巨大压力。

ex.en: He bore a grudge against the company for years after being unfairly dismissed.
ex.zh: 被不公正解雇后，他对该公司怀恨多年。

guarantee.usage: ensure 的近义词；【记】我们保证及时交货。近promise vt.允诺；辨析：guarantee 保证、担保、承诺，可对产品质量、某人行为等担保，后接宾语、不定式或 that 从句；assure 保证、使……确信；派生 guaranty n. 保证，保证书；guar(联想guard"警卫")+an(一个)+tee

ex.en: The ticket will guarantee you free entry.
ex.zh: 这张票可保证你免费入场。

ex.en: Hard work does not guarantee success, but it greatly improves your chances.
ex.zh: 努力并不能保证成功，但会大大增加成功的机会。

ex.en: The washing machine comes with a two-year guarantee.
ex.zh: 这台洗衣机有两年的保修期。

guard.usage: 另 change guard 换哨；mount guard 放哨；relieve guard 接班；n.卫兵；看守，保卫 v.守卫，保卫；看守

ex.en: Two armed guards stood outside the entrance to the building.
ex.zh: 两名武装警卫站在大楼入口外。

ex.en: The president was guarded by secret service agents at all times.
ex.zh: 总统时刻都由特勤局特工护卫。

ex.en: Players must guard against becoming overconfident after an early success.
ex.zh: 选手必须警惕在早期成功后变得过于自信。

ex.en: Under the law, a child's guardian is responsible for his or her education and welfare.
ex.zh: 根据法律，儿童的监护人对其教育和福利负责。

senses: n. 监护；监护人的身份

ex.en: The court awarded guardianship of the two children to their grandmother.
ex.zh: 法院把两个孩子的监护权判给了他们的祖母。

ex.en: Researchers can only guess how climate change will affect rainfall in the region.
ex.zh: 研究人员只能猜测气候变化将如何影响该地区的降雨。

ex.en: Modern weather satellites have replaced much of the guesswork on which farmers once depended for planting.
ex.zh: 现代气象卫星取代了过去农民播种时依赖的大部分猜测。

senses: n. 客人；宾客；特邀嘉宾；房客
n. 特邀嘉宾,客串演员

ex.en: The talk show invites a different guest each week to discuss current social issues.
ex.zh: 该脱口秀每周邀请不同的嘉宾讨论当前的社会议题。

ex.en: Under the guidance of experienced teachers, the students quickly improved their writing skills.
ex.zh: 在经验丰富的教师的指导下，学生们很快提高了写作水平。

ex.en: The agency issued fresh guidance on how firms should protect customers' personal data.
ex.zh: 该机构就企业应如何保护客户个人数据发布了新的指导方针。

ex.en: Young people often turn to their parents for guidance when making major career decisions.
ex.zh: 年轻人在做重大职业决定时常常向父母寻求指导。

ex.en: The museum guide explained how the ancient tools were made.
ex.zh: 博物馆讲解员讲解了这些古代工具是如何制造的。

ex.en: This handbook is a practical guide for parents of disabled children.
ex.zh: 这本手册是残疾儿童家长的一本实用指南。

ex.en: Experienced teachers guide students towards independent thinking rather than memorizing facts.
ex.zh: 经验丰富的教师引导学生独立思考，而不是死记硬背事实。

senses: n. 指导方针；指导原则；准则；参考
guideline.usage: 组合词：guide(指导)+line(线)→指导的线→指导准则；易混辨析：guideline强调实际应用的准则，principle多指哲学、道德上的原则；索引p409

ex.en: Along with Singapore, other governments and mega-corporations are beginning to establish their own guidelines.
ex.zh: 与新加坡一起，其他国家的政府和大公司也开始建立自己的指导方针。

ex.en: establish their own guidelines
ex.zh: 制定他们自己的指导准则

ex.en: Doctors are expected to follow strict guidelines when prescribing powerful painkillers.
ex.zh: 医生在开具强效止痛药处方时应遵循严格的指导准则。

ex.en: The ministry published safety guidelines for schools reopening after the flood.
ex.zh: 教育部发布了洪水后学校复课的安全指导方针。

senses: n. (行业)协会；(中世纪的)行会，同业公会

ex.en: In the Middle Ages, each craft guild set strict standards for the quality of goods sold in the city.
ex.zh: 在中世纪，每个行会都为城内出售的商品质量制定了严格标准。

ex.en: Researchers think that guilt can be a good thing because it may help foster a child's moral development.
ex.zh: 研究人员认为内疚可以是一件好事，因为它可能有助于促进孩子的道德发展。

ex.en: The court established his guilt beyond reasonable doubt.
ex.zh: 法庭确凿无疑地证实了他的罪行。

ex.en: She was overcome with guilt for not visiting her sick mother more often.
ex.zh: 她因没有更常去看望生病的母亲而深感内疚。

senses: adj. 犯罪的，有罪的；内疚的
guilty.usage: 【记】她对失信于朋友感到内疚。反innocent a.无辜的；辨析：criminal 犯罪的、应受惩罚、多作定语；guilty 自觉有罪的、内疚的，也指违法行为；adj.内疚的；有罪的，有过失的；guilt（罪）+y（表形容词）→有罪的，内疚的。；索引p409

ex.en: Unlike so-called basic emotions such as sadness, fear, and anger, guilt emerges a little later, in conjunction with a child's growing grasp of social and moral norms.
ex.zh: 与悲伤、恐惧、愤怒等所谓的基本情绪不同，内疚的出现要晚一些，伴随着孩子对社会和道德规范的理解不断加深而产生。

ex.en: The court found the man guilty of stealing company funds.
ex.zh: 法庭判定该男子犯有盗用公司资金罪。

ex.en: She felt guilty about missing her daughter's school play because of work.
ex.zh: 因为工作而错过女儿的校园演出，她感到很内疚。

ex.en: Learning to play the guitar improves children's coordination and confidence.
ex.zh: 学习弹吉他能提高孩子的协调能力和自信心。

gulf.usage: 【记】他们在海湾边建了一座新城。近gap n.差距；隔阂

ex.en: The gulf between the rich and the poor has widened over the past two decades.
ex.zh: 过去二十年里，贫富之间的鸿沟扩大了。

senses: n. 牙龈；齿龈；牙床；树胶；树脂

ex.en: Doctors advise patients to chew sugar-free gum to stimulate the flow of saliva.
ex.zh: 医生建议病人嚼无糖口香糖以促进唾液分泌。

senses: n. 枪；炮；喷射器（the gun）[sing.] 起跑信号

ex.en: The new law imposes stricter background checks on anyone applying to own a gun.
ex.zh: 新法律对任何申请持枪的人实施更严格的背景审查。

senses: n. [pl.] 内脏；（pl.）（尤指建筑物的）内部
vt. 损毁（建筑物等）的内部；取出…的内脏
n. 勇气与决心,胆量;肠,消化道的下段;(pl.)饭量大的人
vt. 取出内脏;毁坏(建筑物、房间等)的内部

ex.en: Scientists have found that the bacteria in our gut influence mood and memory.
ex.zh: 科学家发现，我们肠道内的细菌会影响情绪和记忆。

senses: n. 男人；小伙子；家伙；伙计们

ex.en: He is the kind of guy who stays calm under pressure and never complains.
ex.zh: 他是那种在压力下保持冷静、从不抱怨的人。

ex.en: Schools that cut gym classes often see a decline in students' concentration and overall health.
ex.zh: 取消体育课的学校常常发现学生的注意力和整体健康水平下降。

ex.en: The new gymnasium will be open to local residents in the evenings as well as to students during the day.
ex.zh: 新体育馆晚上将向当地居民开放，白天则供学生使用。

ex.en: The city council plans to convert the disused gymnasium into a community sports centre open to all residents.
ex.zh: 市议会计划把闲置的体育馆改造成向所有居民开放的社区体育中心。

senses: n. 习惯；道服；习性；惯常行为

phrases.p: fall into/get into the habit of
fall/get out of the habit of

habit.usage: 【记】他习惯每天早起跑步。搭配out of habit出于习惯；n.习惯；瘾；索引p409

ex.en: Once a spending habit is formed, it can be extremely difficult to break.
ex.zh: 消费习惯一旦形成，就可能极难改变。

ex.en: Reading before bed is a healthy habit that can improve the quality of your sleep.
ex.zh: 睡前阅读是一种有助于提高睡眠质量的健康习惯。

ex.en: Researchers found that eating habits formed in childhood tend to persist into adulthood.
ex.zh: 研究人员发现，童年时期形成的饮食习惯往往会延续到成年。

senses: n. (动植物的)自然环境,栖息地
n. （动植物的）生活环境；栖息地
habitat.usage: n.生活环境，栖息地；词根记忆：hab(live，生活)+itat(住的地方)→栖息地；词根hab：to live生活；索引p409

ex.en: The fund will also be used to compensate landowners who set aside habitat.
ex.zh: 该基金还将用于补偿那些留出栖息地的土地所有者。

ex.en: The plan requires individuals and businesses that damage habitat as part of their operations to pay into a fund to replace every acre destroyed with 2 new acres of suitable habitat.
ex.zh: 该计划要求运营中破坏栖息地的个人和企业存入一笔基金，每毁坏一英亩，就用这笔基金建造两英亩新的适宜的栖息地。

ex.en: As cities expand, many animals are losing the natural habitat they depend on for survival.
ex.zh: 随着城市扩张，许多动物正在失去它们赖以生存的自然栖息地。

ex.en: Protecting the panda's bamboo habitat is central to the species' recovery.
ex.zh: 保护大熊猫的竹林栖息地是该物种恢复的关键。

phrases.p: look for signs of human habitation

ex.en: Archaeologists found evidence of human habitation on the island dating back more than four thousand years.
ex.zh: 考古学家发现了四千多年前人类在该岛上居住的证据。

senses: adj. 习惯性的；积习难改的

ex.en: Habitual lateness may cost an employee the trust of both colleagues and managers.
ex.zh: 习惯性迟到可能使员工失去同事和经理的信任。

ex.en: People who habitually skip breakfast tend to overeat later in the day.
ex.zh: 习惯性不吃早餐的人往往在当天晚些时候吃得过多。

senses: v. 砍,切,劈;未经允许侵入(他人的计算机或电话系统)
n. 雇佣文人,写手;二流政客;骑马;出租车
vt. 非法侵入（他人计算机系统）
hack.usage: v.砍，劈；非法侵入；对付， 处理；索引p409

ex.en: Journalists are known to have hacked the phones of up to 5,500 people.
ex.zh: 目前已知电话遭到记者窃听的人数多达5,500人。

ex.en: Cyber criminals hacked into the company's database and stole customer records.
ex.zh: 网络罪犯侵入了公司的数据库，窃取了客户资料。

ex.en: They hacked a path through the dense jungle with axes.
ex.zh: 他们用斧头在茂密的丛林中砍出一条路来。

ex.en: Companies now hire reformed hackers to test whether their security systems can withstand sophisticated cyber attacks.
ex.zh: 公司如今聘请改邪归正的黑客来测试其安全系统能否抵御复杂的网络攻击。

ex.en: Tourists often haggle over the price of souvenirs in the market, unaware that sellers expect such bargaining.
ex.zh: 游客在市场上常为纪念品讨价还价，殊不知卖家本就指望这种讨价还价。

hail.usage: 近义：acclaim vt. 称赞；助记:收到妈妈的mail(邮件)我hail(欢呼)起来

ex.en: The new vaccine was hailed as a major breakthrough in the fight against the disease.
ex.zh: 这种新疫苗被誉为抗击该疾病的重大突破。

senses: n. 头发；（植物叶茎上的）茸毛

ex.en: Experts say stress and poor diet are major causes of hair loss in young people.
ex.zh: 专家说，压力和不良饮食是年轻人脱发的主要原因。

ex.en: A modest haircut before the interview made him look far more professional and confident.
ex.zh: 面试前理了个朴素的发型，让他看起来专业而自信得多。

ex.en: Nearly half of the students surveyed admitted to using their phones during class.
ex.zh: 接受调查的学生中，近一半承认上课时使用手机。

senses: n. 门厅；（大楼里的）走廊；礼堂
n. 礼堂,办公大楼,门厅
hall.usage: 归类记忆:ball球;call叫,喊;fall下降,跌倒;tall高的;wall墙,壁

ex.en: The graduation ceremony was held in the great hall of the university.
ex.zh: 毕业典礼在大学的大礼堂举行。

senses: n. (行进中的)暂停前进,中止,终止
halt.usage: 派生halter n.缰绳,(马)笼头；礼堂(hall)建到一半(half)就停(halt)下来了

ex.en: Work came to a halt when the machine broke down.
ex.zh: 机器一坏，工作便停了下来。

ex.en: The government called for an immediate halt to the nuclear tests.
ex.zh: 政府要求立即停止核试验。

ex.en: Emergency measures failed to halt the spread of the disease.
ex.zh: 紧急措施未能阻止疾病的蔓延。

senses: v. 把……对半分;把……二等分;(使)减半

ex.en: New technology has halved the time needed to process insurance claims, greatly improving customer satisfaction.
ex.zh: 新技术把处理保险理赔所需的时间缩短了一半，大大提高了客户满意度。

senses: n. 蹩脚演员；业余爱好者(c)
v. 演得不自然,作过火表演
ham.usage: 词组ham and eggs火腿肉蛋(固定短语);派生ham-handed adj.笨手笨脚的

ex.en: Processed meats such as ham and bacon have been linked to certain cancers.
ex.zh: 火腿和培根等加工肉类已被认为与某些癌症相关。

ex.en: Nutritionists warn that eating hamburgers regularly may increase the risk of obesity and heart disease.
ex.zh: 营养学家警告说，经常吃汉堡包可能增加肥胖和患心脏病的风险。

ex.en: The fast-food chain has replaced beef burgers with plant-based versions to attract health-conscious consumers.
ex.zh: 这家快餐连锁店已用植物基汉堡替代牛肉汉堡，以吸引注重健康的消费者。

ex.en: The old man spent his entire life in a remote hamlet surrounded by hills and farmland.
ex.zh: 老人一辈子都住在一个群山和农田环绕的偏远小村庄里。

phrases.m: 详尽讨论后得出结论；推敲出

ex.en: He used a hammer to drive the nails into the wooden frame.
ex.zh: 他用锤子把钉子敲进木框里。

ex.en: The chairwoman hammered on the table to silence the excited crowd.
ex.zh: 女主席敲打桌子，让激动的人群安静下来。

ex.en: Negotiators hammered out an agreement after two days of talks.
ex.zh: 经过两天的谈判，谈判代表们敲定了一项协议。

phrases.p: be hampered by a heavy load

hamper.usage: hinder 的近义词；【记】沉重的债务阻碍着公司的发展。近hinder vt.阻碍；妨碍；反义:aid 帮助；他拿着锤子(hammer)阻碍(hamper)大家继续往前走；索引p409

ex.en: Our efforts were severely hampered by a lack of money.
ex.zh: 资金不足使我们的努力大打折扣。

ex.en: Bad weather hampered rescue teams in their attempt to reach the remote village.
ex.zh: 恶劣天气妨碍了救援队前往那个偏远村庄。

ex.en: A shortage of skilled workers continues to hamper the growth of the manufacturing sector.
ex.zh: 熟练工人的短缺继续阻碍着制造业的发展。

ex.en: Limited access to credit has long hampered small farmers in developing countries.
ex.zh: 信贷渠道有限长期以来一直妨碍着发展中国家的小农户。

phrases.p: on the one hand...on the other hand

hand.usage: vt.交给,传递;词组hand down流传下来,传给;hand in交上,递交

ex.en: Please hand in your essay before Friday; late submissions will lose marks.
ex.zh: 请在周五前交论文，迟交将扣分。

ex.en: Designers complain that cheap copies of their handbags are sold on the streets of many tourist cities.
ex.zh: 设计师们抱怨说，他们手提包的廉价仿制品在许多旅游城市的街头有售。

ex.en: Every new employee receives a detailed handbook explaining company rules and safety procedures.
ex.zh: 每位新员工都会收到一本详细的手册，解释公司规章和安全流程。

ex.en: The police officer had to handcuff the suspect before placing him in the police car.
ex.zh: 警察不得不给嫌疑人戴上手铐，然后把他押上警车。

ex.en: Only a handful of students succeeded in solving the problem without any hints from the teacher.
ex.zh: 只有少数学生在没有任何老师提示的情况下成功解出了这道题。

handicap.usage: 【记】身体缺陷并没有阻碍他成功。近disadvantage n.不利条件；同义:disadvantage,drawback,obstacle;反义:advantage;派生:handicapped有生理缺陷的；他的手上（hand）总拿着一个帽子（cap），为了遮掩手上的"缺陷"（handicap）啊→缺陷

ex.en: She can't drive because of her visual handicap.
ex.zh: 她因为视力缺陷不能开车。

ex.en: Lack of a common language was a serious handicap in the negotiations.
ex.zh: 缺乏共同语言是谈判中的一个严重障碍。

ex.en: Small firms are handicapped by rising energy costs and heavy regulation.
ex.zh: 能源成本上升和繁重的监管使小公司处于不利地位。

handicapped.usage: adj.残疾的；残障人士专用的

ex.en: Public buildings should be designed so that physically handicapped people can enter and move around easily.
ex.zh: 公共建筑的设计应便于肢体残疾者进出和活动。

ex.en: He pulled a handkerchief from his pocket and wiped the dust off his glasses.
ex.zh: 他从口袋里掏出手帕，擦去眼镜上的灰尘。

handle.usage: tackle 的近义词；【记】他小心翼翼地提着把手。近deal with处理；发音类似"憨豆"→憨豆先生处理问题时总会出问题→处理；索引p409

ex.en: When the skills mismatch is in the broader economy, though, the focus usually turns to government to handle.
ex.zh: 不过，当技能不匹配问题出现在更宏观的经济领域时，重点通常转向政府来处理。

ex.en: She was hired because she can handle pressure and meet tight deadlines.
ex.zh: 她被录用是因为她能承受压力并在紧迫的期限内完成任务。

ex.en: The new regulations give local authorities more power to handle complaints from consumers.
ex.zh: 新规定赋予地方当局更多处理消费者投诉的权力。

ex.en: Airport staff are trained to handle emergencies calmly and efficiently.
ex.zh: 机场工作人员接受的训练是冷静高效地处理紧急情况。

senses: a. 英俊的；悦目的；数量大的；慷慨的
adj. 漂亮的;慷慨的;数量可观的
handsome.usage: 【记】这位英俊的绅士给了她一笔可观的钱。近attractive a.有魅力的

ex.en: The museum received a handsome donation from a local businessman last year.
ex.zh: 去年，博物馆收到了当地一位商人的一笔可观捐款。

ex.en: Doctors are often criticized for their unreadable handwriting on prescriptions.
ex.zh: 医生常因处方上难以辨认的笔迹而受到批评。

senses: a. 易使用的；容易做的；便利的
handy.usage: 【记】这部词典随身携带很方便。搭配come in handy派得上用场；hand(手)+y(形容词后缀)→手边的

ex.en: Always keep a first-aid kit handy.
ex.zh: 手边要常备急救箱。

ex.en: The hotel is handy for both the railway station and the conference centre.
ex.zh: 这家酒店离火车站和会议中心都很近。

ex.en: This tool is particularly handy for repairing small electronic devices.
ex.zh: 这个工具用来修理小型电子设备特别顺手。

senses: vt.&vi. 悬挂；吊；（使）挂在墙上；（被）绞死
n. [sing.] （衣服、织物等的）悬挂方式
hang.usage: 搭配hang about闲荡；hang on to紧紧抓住；hang on to坚持下去;hang up挂断电话,推迟

ex.en: Family photographs hang on the walls of the narrow corridor.
ex.zh: 狭窄走廊的墙上挂着全家福照片。

senses: vi. （尤指偶然）发生，出现；（作为结果）出现

ex.en: Scientists cannot predict exactly when an earthquake will happen, but they can estimate the probability.
ex.zh: 科学家无法精确预测地震何时发生，但可以估算其概率。

happiness.usage: n.快乐，幸福 Increasingly，single 人士沉醉于线上的digital casino，一个factor 是他们income 的增加，另一个factor 是他们认为这是prove 自我价值的一个opportunity。

ex.en: Studies suggest that money contributes to happiness only up to a certain point.
ex.zh: 研究表明，金钱仅在一定程度内有助于提升幸福感。

senses: a. 快乐的；高兴的；幸福的；满意的；幸运的

ex.en: Employees are more productive when they are happy with their working environment.
ex.zh: 员工对工作环境满意时，工作效率更高。

ex.en: New regulations forbid employers to harass workers who refuse to work unpaid overtime.
ex.zh: 新规禁止雇主骚扰拒绝无偿加班的员工。

senses: n. 烦扰,骚扰;折磨人的东西

ex.en: The company introduced strict policies to prevent sexual harassment in the workplace.
ex.zh: 该公司出台了严格政策，以防止工作场所的性骚扰。

harbor.usage: 【记】轮船正驶入港口。近port n.港口

ex.en: Fishing boats returned to the harbor before the storm reached the coast.
ex.zh: 风暴抵达海岸之前，渔船纷纷返回港口。

senses: n. 港口,海湾;避难所,藏身处

ex.en: The city's harbour was once the busiest port on the entire coast.
ex.zh: 该市的海港曾是整个海岸线上最繁忙的港口。

senses: a. 坚硬的；困苦的；努力的
adj. 硬的,坚固的;努力的,艰苦的;冷酷无情的;强烈的,猛烈的
adv. 努力地;猛烈地;困难地

ex.en: Finding affordable housing in big cities has become increasingly hard for young workers.
ex.zh: 对年轻上班族来说，在大城市找到负担得起的住房已变得越来越难。

senses: v. 使变硬;使变得冷酷无情
harden.usage: hard(硬的)+en(动词后缀,使……)→使变硬；索引p409

ex.en: Attitudes towards immigrants tend to harden during periods of economic uncertainty.
ex.zh: 在经济不确定时期，对移民的态度往往会趋于强硬。
